ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_value IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 ch VARCHAR2(1);
 kword VARCHAR2(300);
 RET NUMBER;
 statment VARCHAR2(100);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100);
 v_count number(5); 
 V_TEMP NUMBER (5);
 BEGIN 
V_COUNT := 0;
P_ORDER ; 
statment := :CALLING_PARAMETERS.PA_FROM; 
IF STATMENT IS NULL THEN
 SELECT count(ACTIVITY_TYPES.SYSOBJ_ID)
 into V_COUNT
 FROM SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS,
 ACTIVITY_SUBJECTS,
 ACTIVITY_TYPES 
 WHERE
 ACTIVITY_TYPES.SYSOBJ_ID = ACTIVITY_SUBJECTS.SYSOBJ_ID AND
 ACTIVITY_TYPES.SUBJ_CODE = ACTIVITY_SUBJECTS.SUBJ_CODE AND
 ACTIVITY_SUBJECTS.SYSOBJ_ID = SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS.SYSOBJ_ID; 
 
 -- (SYSOBJ_ID = SYSOBJ_ID AND SYSOBJ_ID = SYSOBJ_ID);
 --(:LIST_STATUS IS NULL OR CUR.CURCY_STATUS=:LIST_STATUS);
 ELSE
 
 FOR i IN 1..length(:PA_FROM)+1
 LOOP
 ch := SUBSTR(statment,i,1);
 IF ch != ',' THEN
 kword := kword|| ch;
 
 ELSE
 IF (KWORD IS NOT NULL) THEN 
 SELECT count(ACTIVITY_TYPES.SYSOBJ_ID)
 into V_TEMP
 FROM SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS,ACTIVITY_SUBJECTS ,
 ACTIVITY_TYPES 
 
 WHERE
 (ACTIVITY_TYPES.SYSOBJ_ID = ACTIVITY_SUBJECTS.SYSOBJ_ID AND
 ACTIVITY_TYPES.SUBJ_CODE = ACTIVITY_SUBJECTS.SUBJ_CODE AND
 ACTIVITY_SUBJECTS.SYSOBJ_ID = SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS.SYSOBJ_ID)
 AND ACTIVITY_TYPES.SYSOBJ_ID IS NOT NULL AND ACTIVITY_TYPES.SYSOBJ_ID IN (KWORD) ;
 --AND CUR.CURCY_CD IS NOT NULL AND CUR.CURCY_CD IN (KWORD) ;
 --SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS.SYSOBJ_ID
 kword := '';
 V_COUNT := V_COUNT + V_TEMP;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 
 IF :PA_FROM IS NULL THEN
 :parameter.SELECT_STR := ' AND AT_1.SYSOBJ_ID IS NOT NULL' ;
 ELSE
 :parameter.SELECT_STR := ' AND AT_1.SYSOBJ_ID in ( '||:PA_FROM||')' ; 
 
 END IF; 
 if v_count > 0 then

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CLASS_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REPORT_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'V_ORDER',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.V_ORDER);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'SELECT_STR',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.SELECT_STR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 -- ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_STATUS',TEXT_PARAMETER,:LIST_STATUS);
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب'); 
 MESSAGE(' لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;



END;
END;
